codePattern: Letters, digits, underscore or hyphen only
externalIdentityPair: Provide both the external system and reference, or leave both blank
latLongPair: Provide both latitude and longitude, or leave both blank
platePattern: 4 to 12 characters: letters, digits or hyphen
positiveNumber: Must be a number greater than zero
temperatureOnlyWhenControlled: Only allowed when the unit is temperature controlled
timeZone: Must be a valid IANA time zone, for example America/Lima
